findings.title: oauthlib major bump unverified against OAuth flows
findings.problem: oauthlib moves from 3.3.1 to 4.0.0 (a major version) while requests-oauthlib only requires >=3.0.0 with no upper cap, so lock resolution does not prove compatibility. The repo reaches oauthlib indirectly via google_auth_oauthlib.flow.Flow in src/codemie/service/google_oauth/flow_service.py.
findings.impact: If oauthlib 3.x APIs were removed or changed, Google OAuth, Atlassian and exchangelib flows could fail at runtime. Reachability and compatibility were unconfirmed, so severity is capped at major.
findings.recommendation: Keep 4.0.0 (it carries the CVE fix; do not cap below 4). Add or run a test that exercises Flow.authorization_url and fetch_token without mocking oauthlib, and confirm requests-oauthlib and atlassian-python-api work under 4.0.0.
